prayerExcerpt.en-US: Everyone who acknowledges me before others I will acknowledge before my heavenly Father, says the Lord.
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: Todo aquele que se declarar a meu favor diante dos homens, também eu me declararei em favor dele diante do meu Pai que está nos céus, diz o Senhor.

meta.face: A Filipino-Chinese man of about forty with warm golden-tan skin and a ROUND-SQUARE face — wide, flat cheekbones, a broad, low-bridged nose, dark almond eyes with a slight epicanthic fold under thick, straight black brows, a gentle full mouth and a rounded jaw; short straight black hair combed to the side, clean-shaven, and a quiet, steadfast gaze lifted slightly upward.
meta.basis: Born in Binondo about 1594 to a Chinese father and a Tagalog mother, a husband, father and escribano of the Dominican rosary confraternity; the Philippine image type shows him clean-shaven in a white camisa de chino with the rosary in clasped hands and the palm.
